name: XTREME
description: A benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual generalization across nine natural language understanding and generation tasks in 40 languages, built from existing datasets.
citation: Hu, J., Ruder, S., Siddhant, A., et al. (2020). XTREME: A Massively Multilingual Multi-task Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-lingual Generalization. Proceedings of the 37th International Conference on Machine Learning, 4411–4421. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/hu20b.html

license.identifier: Varies by constituent dataset (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: XTREME aggregates existing datasets with differing licenses and terms; there is no single license for the benchmark. Check the license and usage conditions of each constituent dataset before use or redistribution.
